sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns emphasizing micro chops and stutter chops for rhythm foundation with minimal variation in intro and energy peaks in hook sections.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines to support groove with consistent low-end presence across sections with slight variations for bridge.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chord textures incorporating phrase chops that blend with dark mood and minimal variations.

melody_generator.brief: Develop complementary melodic elements utilizing reverse chops to subtly enhance dark atmosphere.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement structure ensuring hook-heavy energy profiles with clear section delineations.

presetor.brief: Manage presets focusing on sample layer settings for micro, phrase, reverse, vocal, and stutter chops.

songgps.brief: Provide energy curve guidance focusing on hooks and minimal variation adherence.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unmixed channel audio emphasizing clarity of sample chops and vocal layers.
